title: Waiting on God
definition: Waiting on God is trusting His timing, wisdom, promises, and character when answers, relief, or direction have not yet come.
summary: Waiting on God is active trust in His faithfulness during delay.
christFocus: Jesus trusted the Father's timing perfectly and strengthens His people to wait with faith and hope.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Waiting on God is not passive resignation. It is active trust. The believer continues to pray, obey, hope, and seek the Lord while waiting for His timing.

Waiting can reveal what the heart trusts. Delay may expose impatience, fear, control, or unbelief. Yet God uses waiting to strengthen faith and deepen dependence.

The Lord is not slow in the way people often think. His timing is wise, even when hidden. Those who wait on Him are renewed in strength.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Waiting can make people feel forgotten or tempted to force their own way. This doctrine matters because it teaches believers to trust God's character when His timing is not understood.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Keep praying and obeying while you wait. Do not use delay as an excuse for disobedience. Ask God to renew your strength and align your desires with His will.
